in_hindi.name: चंती
in_hindi.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word चन्ति (chanti), meaning joyful, pleasing, delightful. It is also associated with the use of chandan (sandalwood) due to the similarity in pronunciation.

in_marathi.name: Chanti
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chanti हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chanti is a Sanskrit name, derived from the word 'chandan' meaning 'sandalwood'. In Hindu mythology, Chanti is considered the goddess of joy and delight. She is often depicted holding a plate of flowers or a fan to dispel sorrow.
